profile.intro: I'm a <highlight>frontend enthusiast</highlight> from Yantai, Shandong. I currently work as a frontend developer at <highlight>Sohu in Beijing</highlight> 🧱
profile.undergraduate: I studied Software Engineering at <highlight>Qufu Normal University in Jining</highlight>. While there, I served in the university's <highlight>National Flag Guard</highlight> 🇨🇳 and trained incoming students. I sometimes wish I had joined the military for the experience 😕.
profile.graduate: After graduation, I spent three years pursuing a master's degree at <highlight>Northeastern University in Shenyang</highlight>. Compared with backend development and algorithms, I found that I <highlight>enjoy frontend development more</highlight>. Doing what you love can't be wrong 🤔
profile.hobbies: Besides coding, I enjoy playing basketball with friends 🏀 and working out 🏋 ...
profile.dream: As a child, I dreamed of becoming an astronaut 👨‍🚀. These days I focus less on one grand dream and more on a series of <highlight>small goals</highlight> 🌟
profile.principle: I hope to stay true to myself and keep learning frontend development one step at a time 🤔
profile.career: I'll keep learning frontend technologies 🎯 and work toward becoming a <highlight>senior frontend engineer</highlight> in three to five years! 👷

goal.middle: not just to build something impressive 🐂 🍺,
goal.suffix: but to bring fun ideas to life

timeline.codingJourney: I started with C and Java, then gradually moved to JavaScript. Frontend is fun!

timeline.reunion: No more long-distance relationship with my girlfriend! 🎉
